description: Returns LLM-optimized instructions for generating Trident diagrams, including quick reference, critical rules (especially Y-axis!), spacing guidelines, common patterns, color conventions, and error prevention checklist. Use this before generating Trident markup (a whole diagram as text). Not needed up front in a live session that edits a document with add_node / add_connection — load it there only for domain conventions (BPMN/UML/flowchart layout, ERD, C4).
name: get_generator_guide
